checks.title: Confirm metric decision and owner
checks.instructions: Name the engineering owner, first reviewable metric and bounded improvement question. Exclude issue writes, staff rankings, notifications and claimed outcome effects.

checks.title: Bind exact team and service
checks.instructions: Record tenant, team, service or repository, environment, ownership map, timezone, authorized sources and window boundaries.

checks.title: Freeze one versioned metric
checks.instructions: Agree on population, numerator, denominator, distinct item/event identity, exclusions, target and minimum coverage before observing results. Select delivery, quality or reliability family.

checks.title: Freeze baseline and repeat policy
checks.instructions: Record equal window duration, nonoverlap, source revisions and compatibility checks. A changed team, service, source mapping or rule starts a new baseline; partial data stays not_evaluable.

checks.title: Bind Analyst and Delivery capabilities
checks.instructions: Inspect existing Engineering Operations Analyst and Engineering Delivery Coordinator Crews, owner and access; reuse compatible identities or propose reviewed creation.

checks.title: Probe engineering and issue records
checks.instructions: Read representative authorized metric rows and current issue/owner records; record exact IDs, revisions, times, missing partitions and privacy limits.

checks.title: Validate observation and review
checks.instructions: Insert blocking validators before Delivery and reporting. Exercise wrong team/rule, rate arithmetic, partial coverage, false trend, duplicate case, stale issue, false approval and outcome claim.

checks.title: Review concrete Automation plan
checks.instructions: Show Crew IDs, source paths, rule revision, validator steps, owner review, stable case key, later observation method, manual route, cost and notifications.

checks.title: Run one real team metric manually
checks.instructions: Save authorized source reads, recomputed counts and rates, both artifacts, owner correction or decision and an incomplete-data control. Fictional examples do not complete setup.

checks.title: Choose manual or reviewed recurrence
checks.instructions: Manual-only is valid. A schedule or event requires authenticated scope, stable IDs, source freshness, deduplication, cost, notifications and explicit activation after a passing manual route.
